ns0:svg.ns0:title: Routing Mobility
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Routing as implemented in the PULSE A0.9 instrument. The companion routing guide provides equivalent decision rules and question IDs.

ns0:rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(9%,41%,33%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: 1. Mobility background and journey
After consent, adult confirmation and site choice, transport and real-journey constructs use separate gates. Non-car users remain included.
PULSE citizen survey | A0.9 instrument | 6 November 2026 | Routing logic is unchanged by the compact presentation.

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(90%,95%,92%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Background: current travel and driving roles
Usual modes and the main mode describe everyday travel. Current driving is asked only if it is not already reported. Paid-work driving asks about work powertrains separately.
A-MOB-01 / A-MOB-PRIMARY; R-DRIVE-01; A-PRO-DRIVE-01 / A-PRO-PT-01

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(97%,93%,85%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Can the future transport offers be compared?
The scenario must not be rejected AND at least two offers must be evaluable.
Declining to give the trip purpose does not block offer evaluation.
B-TRIP-CONTEXT != 97; at least two codes 1-3 in B-MODE-EVAL

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(97%,93%,85%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Is there a recurring real journey?
One journey in the past four weeks is selected as the reference. Current mode and a
realistic alternative are established for that journey.
A-JRN-01 = 1-4; A-JRN-02; C-ALT-01

ns0:g.ns0:text: Availability is specific to the hypothetical trip
Actual weekly modes do not automatically remove future offers. Choosing only one
evaluable offer, no evaluable offer, or rejecting the trip scenario skips these choice
cards.
Transport DCE is before COM-B; both use their own reference context.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Separate the current mode from the alternative
A confirmed alternative shows capability, opportunity and reflective motivation. A
known current mode shows habit, even without a feasible alternative. Intention is
shown when an alternative is valid; conditional intentions need all necessary changes
to be named.
C-ALT-01 = 1-5; or 6 + C-ALT-USED; or 97 + C-ALT-02. C-COND-01 controls conditional intentions.
